synopsis.NSW_FA001: A strong high pressure system over the Tasman Sea is maintaining northeasterly winds across the coastal waters. Very little change in weather pattern is forecast through the week due to the slow movement of the high. A cold front is then forecast to cross the state during the weekend into early next week, bringing a southerly change in its wake.
synopsis.VIC_FA001: A high pressure system centred over the Tasman Sea will drift slowly eastwards as a cold front approaches from the west on Friday. This cold front will cross the State on Saturday and Sunday with a secondary trough crossing late Sunday or Monday.
synopsis.TAS_FA001: A slow moving high over the Tasman Sea directs a warm northwesterly flow over Tasmania this week. A weak trough lingers over the state today and tomorrow. A stronger trough is expected to move over Tasmania on Friday, with a cold front following Saturday evening. Another trough is forecast to develop off the east coast on Sunday.
